name: Gridgets — GNOME Shell Widgets
description:
GNOME widgets for your desktop. A GNOME widget extension that places clocks, weather, system monitors, notes, music, and more onto a desktop grid.
* Place image, GIF, weather, time, notes, music, system monitors, and clipboard widgets on a desktop grid.
* Access your system clipboard history locally to provide a clipboard history widget.
* Drag, resize, and customise each widget independently.
